timing_scope: resident normalized input -> synchronized result; deployment modes include network forward and standard B-spline refits; excludes dataset generation, file I/O, plotting, and request transport

mode_scopes.network-forward: model.forward_deployment(points), retaining the pilot solve but skipping the final training-only surrogate solve
mode_scopes.refit-network: one standard B-spline refit per curve from materialized network-domain outputs; includes model-to-refit-device transfer
mode_scopes.refit-chord: knot warp plus one chord-domain standard refit per curve from materialized outputs; includes model-to-refit-device transfer
mode_scopes.learned-chord: network-forward plus knot warp and chord-domain learned refit
mode_scopes.verified-fast: network-forward plus exact learned check and conditional repair; no feasible-subset compaction
mode_scopes.verified-compact: network-forward plus exact verification/repair and greedy compaction

latency_semantics: batch latency is request latency; median_ms_per_curve is throughput amortization and must not be reported as batch=1 latency

training_lower_bound.scope: model forward + reconstruction-MSE backward + AdamW step; excludes the full v13 teacher losses, data loading, host-to-device transfer, validation, and checkpointing, so it is only a lower bound
